reports.clinical: 75-year-old woman referred for assessment of a lymphoproliferative disorder. Cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy (nodes up to 1.5 cm). No splenomegaly. B symptoms (night sweats and weight loss). Full blood count: Hb 156 g/L, WBC 25.3 x10^9/L, neutrophils 4.7 x10^9/L, platelets 259 x10^9/L; no cytopenias. Monocytes 0.85 x10^9/L. Clonal B-cell count 19.4 x10^9/L.
reports.morphology: Peripheral blood film and bone marrow aspirate/trephine. Smudge cells are frequent. Prolymphocytes 3%. Immunohistochemistry: positive for LEF1 and negative for cyclin D1. Reported by SK/DB, 28 Oct 2026.
reports.flow_cytometry: Flow cytometry, peripheral blood. Gating on CD19+ events (83% of lymphocytes). Clonal B cells are identified (lambda restricted) showing dim surface Ig. Phenotype: CD5+, CD10-, CD20 dim, CD22+, CD23+, CD38+, CD43+, CD79b-, CD200+, FMC7-, IgD+. Reported by SK/DB, 28 Oct 2026. Specimen H26-8082.
reports.cytogenetics: Interphase FISH on the clonal B-cell population. del(13q14) detected by FISH. No trisomy 12 detected by FISH. No del(11q) detected by FISH. No del(17p) detected by FISH. No t(11;14) CCND1::IGH detected by FISH. Reported by SK/DB, 28 Oct 2026.
reports.molecular: Targeted NGS panel (lymphoid). IGHV mutated (96.4% germline identity). No TP53 mutation detected. No NOTCH1 mutation detected. No SF3B1 mutation detected. Reported by SK/DB, 28 Oct 2026.

reports.molecular: Targeted NGS panel (lymphoid). TP53 pathogenic variant detected (VAF 21%). IGHV unmutated (99.3% germline identity). Reported by AO/SK, 01 Feb 2026.

reports.clinical: 73-year-old man referred for assessment of a lymphoproliferative disorder. No lymphadenopathy. Splenomegaly (spleen 16 cm on ultrasound). No B symptoms. Full blood count: Hb 85 g/L, WBC 6.3 x10^9/L, neutrophils 3.2 x10^9/L, platelets 208 x10^9/L; cytopenias noted. Monocytes 0.11 x10^9/L. Clonal B-cell count 2.8 x10^9/L.
reports.morphology: Peripheral blood film and bone marrow aspirate/trephine. Medium-sized lymphoid cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and circumferential villous projections (hairy cells) are present. The aspirate was a dry tap; the trephine shows increased reticulin fibrosis. An interstitial infiltrate of cells with clear cytoplasm and a fried-egg appearance is present. An intrasinusoidal pattern of infiltration is present in the trephine. Immunohistochemistry: annexin A1 positive, cyclin D1 positive. Reported by JM/RP, 02 Jun 2026.
reports.flow_cytometry: Flow cytometry, peripheral blood. Gating on CD19+ events (79% of lymphocytes). Clonal B cells are identified (kappa restricted) showing bright surface Ig. Phenotype: CD5-, CD10-, CD20 bright, CD22-, CD23-, CD38+, CD43-, CD79b+, CD200+, FMC7+, CD11c+, CD25+, CD103+, CD123+. Reported by JM/RP, 02 Jun 2026. Specimen H26-3066.
reports.cytogenetics: Conventional karyotype. Normal karyotype 46,XY[20]. Reported by JM/RP, 02 Jun 2026.
reports.molecular: Targeted NGS panel (lymphoid). BRAF p.V600E (c.1799T>A) detected (VAF 33%). No MAP2K1 mutation detected. Reported by JM/RP, 02 Jun 2026.

reports.clinical: 63-year-old woman referred for assessment of a lymphoproliferative disorder. No lymphadenopathy. Splenomegaly (spleen 15 cm on ultrasound). Clonal B-cell count 26.2 x10^9/L. Serum electrophoresis: IgM lambda paraprotein 21 g/L.
reports.morphology: Peripheral blood film and bone marrow aspirate/trephine. A lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate with plasmacytoid lymphocytes and occasional Dutcher bodies is present. A clonal B-cell population is present, lambda light-chain restricted, with moderate-intensity surface immunoglobulin. reports.cytogenetics: Interphase FISH on the clonal B-cell population. No t(11;14) CCND1::IGH detected by FISH. No del(17p) detected by FISH. No del(7q) detected by FISH. Reported by LT/AO, 22 Sep 2026.
reports.molecular: Targeted NGS panel (lymphoid). MYD88 p.L265P detected (VAF 28%). No CXCR4 mutation detected. No TP53 mutation detected. Reported by LT/AO, 22 Sep 2026.
